body:
Revisiting this issue, I went through all of the subclasses of `Texture2D` listed in the documentation and how their `get_image()` methods were defined. This is what I found:

- AnimatedTexture - depends on current frame
	- `frames[current_frame].texture->get_image()`
- AtlasTexture - new image instance
	- `atlas_image->get_region(_get_region_rect())`
	- `get_region()` blits into a new image
- CameraTexture - new instance(?)
	- `RenderingServer::get_singleton()->texture_2d_get`
- CanvasTexture - depends on diffuse_texture
	- `diffuse_texture->get_image()`
- CompressedTexture2D - new instance(?)
	- `RS::get_singleton()->texture_2d_get(texture)`
- CurveTexture - empty image
	- `Ref<Image>`
- CurveXYZTexture - empty image
	- `Ref<Image>`
- DPITexture - new instance(?)
	- `RenderingServer::get_singleton()->texture_2d_get(rid)`
- DrawableTexture2D - new instance(?)
	- `RS::get_singleton()->texture_2d_get(texture)`
- ExternalTexture - empty image
	- No override defined
- GradientTexture1D - new instance(?)
	- `RenderingServer::get_singleton()->texture_2d_get(texture)`
- GradientTexture2D - new instance(?)
	- `RenderingServer::get_singleton()->texture_2d_get(texture)`
- ImageTexture - new instance(?)
	- `RenderingServer::get_singleton()->texture_2d_get(texture)`
- MeshTexture - empty image
	- No override defined
- NoiseTexture2D - shared image instance
	- `image`
- PlaceholderTexture2D - empty image
	- `Ref<Image>()`
- PortableCompressedTexture2D - new instance(?)
	- `RenderingServer::get_singleton()->texture_2d_get(texture)`
- Texture2DRD - new instance(?)
	- `RS::get_singleton()->texture_2d_get(texture_rid)`
- ViewportTexture - new instance(?)
	- `RS::get_singleton()->texture_2d_get(vp->texture_rid)`
